about.title: Over 75 Years of Wood Excellence in Egypt
about.p1: Founded in 1950, Antoine Youssef Achaia Sons is one of Egypt's oldest and most trusted names in wood trading and manufacturing. For over seven decades, we have supplied the Egyptian market with premium wood products sourced from around the world.
about.p2: We operate our own factory, allowing us to maintain strict quality control across everything we produce — from doors to MDF panels, plywood, block board, and natural veneer. Our steel and Turkish steel-wood doors bring durability alongside refined style.
about.p3: As a major distributor of laminate flooring — including AGT, TerraClick, VarioClick we offer many different thickness and resistance options to suit every budget and design vision.

lumber.title: Wood, Lumber & Veneer
lumber.desc: From raw timber and board materials to natural veneer and edge banding — a complete range of wood products for manufacturers, contractors, and craftsmen.
lumber.about_body: We supply a broad range of raw and processed wood materials to suit every stage of production. Our solid lumber and timber are sourced from sustainably managed forests, available in a variety of species and dimensions. We carry MDF, HDF, particle board, and chipboard for interior fitout and furniture manufacturing. Our natural veneer selection spans dozens of species — from oak and walnut to exotic cuts — while our engineered veneer offers uniform grain and consistent quality at scale. Edge banding solutions in matching species and finishes complete any panel or furniture piece with a clean, professional result.

custom_mfg.subtitle: Our Factory
custom_mfg.title: Custom Manufacturing
custom_mfg.description: With our own factory, we can produce fully customized wood products built to your exact specifications — any design, dimension, or finish.
custom_mfg.details: Having our own manufacturing facility sets Achaia Wood apart. We don't just distribute — we build. Whether you're a contractor needing 500 doors to a specific spec, a designer commissioning a one-of-a-kind furniture piece, or a developer fitting out an entire building, our factory team can deliver. Every custom order is crafted with the same quality materials we stock and sell.

flooring.description: We are an authorized distributor of premium Turkish laminate flooring brands. Browse our full range below and contact us for pricing and availability.
flooring.agt_corvina_desc: The AGT Corvina Collection merges modern craftsmanship with natural wood aesthetics, offering an elegant, highly durable design that elevates any home interior.
flooring.agt_bella_neo_desc: The AGT Bella Neo Collection offers a nature inspired design that refreshes the atmosphere of any home or workplace.
flooring.agt_natura_select_desc: Inspired by nature, the AGT Natura Select Collection combines sophisticated natural textures and warm tones with lasting durability to create a peaceful atmosphere in your home or office.
flooring.agt_effect_desc: Utilizing special technology to perfectly mimic real wood, the Effect Collection provides a stylish, water-resistant, and underfloor heating compatible solution for comfort and durability.
flooring.tc_7mm_desc: Classic laminate with a warm, inviting tone and click-lock installation system.
flooring.tc_8mm_desc: Premium 8mm laminate with enhanced durability and a wide selection of wood-inspired finishes.
flooring.vc_standard_desc: The VarioClick Standard Collection combines rich decor options with scratch-resistant, antibacterial properties to bring lasting aesthetic appeal to any space.
flooring.vc_chevron_desc: Premium wide-board design with a textured surface and enhanced sound insulation.
flooring.vc_naturel_line_desc: The VarioClick Naturel Line brings warm, nature-inspired wood tones with a smooth finish suited for both residential and commercial spaces.
